unit: 时态进阶 · 现在完成进行时
summary: have/has been + 现在分词：动作从过去持续到现在、强调「一直在做」，且可能继续下去。

rules.title: 结构与含义：一直在做
rules.detail: have/has been + 现在分词。强调动作从过去开始持续到现在（且可能继续），突出过程与持续性，常与 all day、for hours、since 连用。

examples.en: It has been raining since morning.
examples.zh: 从早上开始一直在下雨。

examples.en: I have been waiting for you for two hours.
examples.zh: 我已经等了你两个小时了。

rules.title: 与现在完成时的区别：过程 vs 结果
rules.detail: 完成时强调结果（已完成 / 已发生几次）；完成进行时强调过程（一直在做，可能未完成）。延续性动词两者常可互换，但含义侧重不同。

examples.zh: 我把这本书读完了。（强调结果）

examples.en: I have been reading the book.
examples.zh: 我一直在读这本书。（强调过程，可能还没读完）

rules.title: since 从句用一般过去时
rules.detail: 主句用完成时或完成进行时，since 引导的从句用一般过去时；since + 过去时间点同理。

examples.en: She has been working here since she graduated.
examples.zh: 她毕业后就一直在这里工作。

examples.en: They have been living in Beijing since 2015.
examples.zh: 从 2015 年起他们就一直在北京生活。

pitfalls: 瞬间动词不能用完成进行：❌ He has been dying for a week. → die 不能持续，应说 has been dead for a week
状态动词不用进行：❌ I have been knowing her for years. → ✓ I have known her for years.
强调「已完成几个」用完成时：I have written three reports this morning.（写完了三份）↔ I have been writing reports all morning.（一上午都在写）

compare.right: 现在完成进行时 have/has been doing

rows.l: 强调结果：已完成、已发生几次
rows.r: 强调过程：一直在做，可能继续

rows.l: I have written three letters.（写完了三封）
rows.r: I have been writing letters all morning.（一上午都在写）

rows.l: 常与 already / yet / just / ever 连用
rows.r: 常与 for / since / all day / recently 连用

rows.l: 瞬间动词可用：has left / has lost
rows.r: 瞬间动词不可用：❌ has been leaving

questions.stem: — Why are your hands so dirty? — I ___ the car for the whole morning.
questions.explain: for the whole morning + 手现在脏（结果延续），强调「一直在修」，用现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: — I'm sure Andrew will win the first prize in the final. — I think so. He ___ for it for months.
questions.explain: for months 表示从过去持续到现在，且「获奖在望」说明仍在准备，用现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: — Have you finished your homework? — Not yet. I ___ it.
questions.explain: Not yet 说明还没做完、动作仍在进行，用现在完成进行时 have been doing。

questions.stem: He has been playing football since he ___ a child.
questions.explain: since 引导的从句用一般过去时 was（主句是完成进行时）。

questions.stem: It ___ (rain) since last night, and the streets are still wet.
questions.explain: since last night + 街还湿着（可能仍在下），强调持续，用 has been raining。

questions.stem: — Why are you so tired? — I ___ (play) basketball all afternoon.
questions.explain: all afternoon 持续到现在且人已累，强调「一下午一直在打」，用 have been playing。

questions.stem: I have been knowing her since we were at school together.
questions.explain: know 是状态动词，不能用进行形式，改用现在完成时 have known。

questions.stem: 我学英语已经学了十年了，现在还在学。（翻译整句）
answer: i have been learning english for ten years.
i have been studying english for ten years.
questions.explain: 「学了十年且还在学」强调动作持续，用现在完成进行时 have been learning。
